title: Settings
subtitle: Project, look, notifications, AI, lists and account. Most of it you set once.

push.lateBody: The {label} report has been due for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
push.testBody: Reminders will reach this device like this.

notifications.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.
notifications.enableFailed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Check the browser's permissions.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Reminders come to your phone or computer as notifications. The app never sends email.
notifications.stateOn: On. Reminders come to this device.
notifications.stateBlocked: The browser blocks notifications. Allow them in the browser's site settings.
notifications.stateInstall: On iPhone, add the app to the home screen first (explained below).
notifications.stateUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.devicesHint: Every phone and computer where you turned notifications on.
notifications.deviceCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# device} other {# devices}}
notifications.quietHint: No notifications in these hours. Reminders you set on tasks still come.

kindHints.taskReminders: When you give a task a reminder time.
kindHints.meetingReminders: About 20 minutes before a meeting starts.
kindHints.briefReady: When your morning plan is ready.
kindHints.lateReports: Once, when a partner's report passes its due date.

readOnly: The project is archived. Project settings are read-only; look, notifications and account can still change.

project.title: Project
project.hint: The app's name and the project's details. Reports and exports use them.
project.appNameHint: Shown in the menu and the tab title. It can stay like this until you find a name.
project.projectCodeHint: The code from the donor or SCI; it appears on report covers.
project.spellingHint: Claude writes English reports in this spelling (organisation or organization).
project.yearsError: The end year cannot be before the start year, and a project runs at most 15 years.

look.title: Look and language
look.hint: Light or dark theme, interface language and time zone.
look.languageHint: Menus and buttons. The language of files and reports does not change.
look.timeZoneHint: Dates and reminders use Türkiye time.
look.shortcutsHint: On a laptop, the ? key opens this list too.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.hint: The morning plan warns you when a day holds more work than these hours.
hours.error: The end time must be after the start, with at least one day chosen.

install.title: Install on your phone
install.hint: Add the app to the home screen: it opens full screen, reads without internet and gets notifications.
install.installedHint: You are opening the app from the home screen.
install.iphoneHere: You are on an iPhone or iPad now.
install.androidHere: You can install it from the Chrome menu.
install.androidSteps: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu at the top right and choose Install app.
install.laptopSteps: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right of the address bar.

ai.title: AI
ai.hint: What Claude does, what it spends and what it never reads. You approve every suggestion; Claude changes nothing on its own.
ai.notConfigured: Claude is not connected yet. Mehmet needs to add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on Vercel.
ai.enabledHint: Turn it off and summaries, suggestions and the assistant stop; your data stays where it is.
ai.capHint: At the cap, Claude stops until the month ends. Suggested: 20 USD.
ai.capReached: This month's cap is reached. Claude works again on the 1st, or you can raise the cap.
ai.capNear: 80% of this month's cap is used.
ai.memoryHint: What Claude remembers about you and the project, plus the project glossary. Correct or delete anything.
ai.aiOffHint: These folders and files are never sent to Claude or to the search model.
ai.aiOffFiles: {count, plural, one {# file closed on its own} other {# files closed one by one}}
ai.aiOffNone: No closed folders or files. You can close one from its menu.
ai.modelsHint: The Claude model each job runs on. The defaults are usually best.

lists.title: Lists
lists.hint: The names and calendars used across the app. Set them once and update them when needed.
lists.docTypesHint: Claude sorts files into these types. {count, plural, one {# type} other {# types}}.
lists.tagsHint: Rename, merge or remove. {count, plural, one {# tag} other {# tags}}.
lists.partnersHint: Organisations, contacts and report calendars live on the Partners page.
lists.seasonsHint: Harvest periods behind the timeline. {count, plural, one {# season} other {# seasons}}.
lists.holidaysHint: Public and religious holidays, left out of working days. {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
lists.periodsHint: The IPTT columns and the stretches reports cover. {count, plural, one {# period} other {# periods}}.
lists.templatesHint: Note, meeting and report templates. {count, plural, one {# template} other {# templates}}.
lists.namingHint: Claude follows this pattern when it suggests file names. Leave it empty for short, clear names.
lists.namingPlaceholder: For example: YYYY-MM-DD Partner – File type – Subject

docTypes.title: File types
docTypes.description: Claude puts every file you upload into one of these types. Give a Turkish and an English name; the description is a hint for Claude.
docTypes.descriptionPlaceholder: When is it this type? For example: partners' quarterly narrative reports
docTypes.moveTitle: Where should the files of the removed types go?

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Renaming a tag changes it everywhere. Give it the name of another tag and the two merge.
tags.none: No tags yet. They show here as you tag notes, tasks and files.
tags.uses: {count, plural, =0 {not used} one {used once} other {used # times}}
tags.confirmDelete: {count, plural, one {It comes off # item.} other {It comes off # items.}} Tap again to delete.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: The templates you choose from when you open a new note, meeting or report.
templates.name: Name
templates.howToAdd: For a page template, choose Save as template in a note's menu. For a task set, select tasks in Tasks and press Save as task set.

account.title: Account
account.hint: Your passkeys, recovery codes and signed-in devices. No password: you sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
account.passkeysHint: Each passkey lives on a device or in an account such as iCloud Keychain or Google Password Manager.
account.syncedHint: This passkey also works on your other devices in the same account.
account.removeConfirm: You can no longer sign in with this passkey.
account.addHere: Add a passkey on this device
account.recoveryHint: If you lose every device with a passkey, these codes get you in.
account.recoveryLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No codes left} one {# code left} other {# codes left}}
account.recoveryConfirm: 10 new codes are created and none of the old ones work any more.
account.sessionsHint: If you see a device you do not know or no longer use, sign it out.
account.othersConfirm: {count, plural, one {The session on # other device ends.} other {The sessions on # other devices end.}}
account.othersDone: {count, plural, =0 {There was nothing to sign out} one {# session signed out} other {# sessions signed out}}
account.pairHint: Add your phone or another computer with this code; that device creates its own passkey.
account.pairStep2: Type this code and create a passkey.
account.pairUntil: The code works for 10 minutes, until {time}.
account.noPasskeys: No passkeys on this account yet.

data.title: Data
data.hint: What you deleted, and the project's data.
data.trashHint: {count, plural, =0 {Empty.} one {# item.} other {# items.}} Deleted things go for good after 30 days.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.hint: What Claude writes on its own, and your saved instructions. Everything is kept on Briefs; anything they suggest to change arrives in the Inbox.
helpers.dailyBriefHint: Three lines at the top of Today at 08:00 on working days.
helpers.weeklyReviewHint: Friday at 16:00: what was done and what slipped, next week and three suggested objectives.
helpers.partnerCheckHint: On the first working day of the month, finds late partner reports and suggests follow-up tasks.
helpers.briefsHint: Everything your helpers and instructions wrote.
helpers.recipesHint: Instructions that run with one tap in the assistant panel. On a partner or meeting page they use that page; they can also run on their own at set times.
helpers.aiOff: Claude is not connected or is switched off; instructions cannot run for now.

schedules.monthly_first_workday: First working day of the month

dialog.description: Claude follows this instruction as written every time it runs. The result is kept on Briefs.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.namePlaceholder: e.g. Monthly note to the donor
dialog.instructionsHint: Say what to write, in which language and how long. Claude reads the day's records and the page you run it on.
dialog.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Summarise open tasks with this partner, what we wait for from them and the latest decisions, in bullet points.
dialog.modelHint: Haiku is quick and cheap; Sonnet is more careful; Opus is the strongest and the most expensive.
dialog.scheduleHint: A scheduled run has no page; Claude works from the day's records.
